title: Network dynamics of HFOs (Lin & Stacey; Michigan): filtered and RMS iEEG snippets around interictal HFOs, 2 patients (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of the Pennsieve dataset 'Network dynamics of HFOs' from the Stacey Lab at the University of Michigan. It contains 80-500 Hz filtered intracranial EEG snippets and RMS envelopes around interictal high frequency oscillations (HFOs), plus background snippets, from two epilepsy surgery patients with good and poor outcomes. Per-snippet events, electrode coordinates, and seizure-onset-zone and resection masks support HFO network analysis in relation to surgical outcome.
methods_description: HFOs were detected with the authors' HFO-Network pipeline. Up to 500 snippets of 1441 samples at 3600 Hz around HFOs were released per electrode, showing all channels, as 80-500 Hz filtered signal with RMS envelope channels. Background snippets were also included. The released MAT files were repackaged to BrainVision float32 with per-snippet events and electrode coordinates in electrodes.tsv, without recomputing any values.
